title: comments and test titles outside the release core name things by their position (field five, the first two, invariant 2, four lines up), which goes stale as the list grows
body:
## The problem

The rule in the user-scope AGENTS.md has a second half beside the counts that 0220 removes: "nothing is named by its position in a list (`check 14`): such numbers mean nothing, and are wrong as soon as something is added." 0209 renamed the release core's steps and rows. dc's read for 0220 (its section "Positional names, found, not fixed") also found positional names outside the release core, where a comment or title points at something by its place: "field five", "the first two", "the third member", "invariant 2", "four lines up", "the two tests below". Each one goes stale when a line, a test or a list member is added, and the line-distance pointer at lib/cmd/check is stale already.

vc re-read dc's list against main after the 0.1.14 cut (593109bf). The release core holds no step or row number now; the remaining "row 3" mentions there name issue 0088's own row, a dated record, and stay. These remain, with main's line numbers:

- `lib/builtins:78` -- "the pipe past field five"
- `lib/cmd/check:366` -- "Twenty lines below" (stale: the warn it points at is further down)
- `lib/cmd/clean:414` -- "the last five arguments"
- `lib/cmd/version:166`, `:208`, `:304` -- "invariant 2", "invariant 1"; with `tests/unit/version.bats:369`, `:485`, `:528` ("Invariant 1", "INVARIANT 1", "INVARIANT 2"): the invariants are numbered, so each needs a name
- `lib/help:668` -- "which of the first two this is"
- `lib/install:553` -- "The third member of the vendored_paths / vendored_dir_files family"
- `lib/install:803` -- "The first two are read back"
- `lib/install:1502` -- "neither of the first two can be said"
- `lib/release.steps:77` -- "principle 2"
- `lib/resolve:71` -- "the first three tiers command_origin reports"
- `tests/lib/test_helper.bash:880` -- "the first two forms only"
- `tests/unit/buildfmt.bats:314` -- "`builtin_check_critic` two functions above"
- `tests/unit/documentation.bats:13` -- "so the first two need it"
- `tests/unit/fullcycle.bats:2666` -- "The first two were refused ... the third"
- `tests/unit/review.bats:495` -- "the two above are not"
- `tests/unit/runlog.bats:892` -- "THE THIRD TEST CARRIES THE WEIGHT" (already wrong: the arm it means is the fourth of its section)
- `tests/unit/updatenotice.bats:496` -- "the two below are what hold the claim"
- `tests/unit/vendor.bats:625` -- "The two tests below are the two directions"

The list is a read, not a scan, so the builder reads each file's neighbourhood for others of the same kind. Not in scope: "those two" where it names the two things in the sentence before it, which is a pronoun, not a position; fleet's files (leaving devbin under 0216); lib/pages (0208 read them).

## Done when

1. Each entry above names what it points at (the function, the test's title, the invariant's name, the field's name) instead of its position or distance, keeping its technical reason; the numbered invariants in lib/cmd/version and their tests get names, used in both.
2. Any other positional name the builder finds anywhere in lib/, bin/ and tests/ (fleet's files and lib/pages excepted) is fixed the same way and listed in the Resolution; widened from "the same files" on 2026-10-24, when the builder's tree-wide read found more of the class.
3. No behaviour changes: the diffs are comments, test titles and section headings only, and the full suite is green.

## Resolution

Fixed at 29d668fd on main in the 0.1.15 batch, on vc's landing pair at 261286d6 of 2026-10-26: land220's full suite (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/land220/tmp/test/20261026-0642.bats.{out,errors}) and the public candidate's (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/st0010/cand220/tmp/test/20261026-0652.bats.{out,errors}), each with every test passing, only the standing skips, and its seal empty; main's tree outside intent/ equals 261286d6's (dc built it as c3798a72 on vc's word, with Done when 2 widened to the whole of lib/, bin/ and tests/ at 820f6fe7, 2026-10-24; vc landed it).

- **What was renamed:** every positional name in a comment or test title across lib/, bin/ and tests/ (fleet's files and lib/pages excepted). A field, a test, an arm, a principle, an invariant or a step is now named by what it is, not by its place, its number, or its distance in lines.
- **The issue's entries:** the issue lists lib/builtins, lib/cmd/check, lib/cmd/clean, lib/cmd/version and its tests, lib/help, lib/install, lib/release.steps, lib/resolve, tests/lib/test_helper.bash, buildfmt.bats, documentation.bats, fullcycle.bats, review.bats, runlog.bats, updatenotice.bats and vendor.bats. Every entry is fixed. The version invariants are named DERIVED FILES FIRST, THE VERSION FILE LAST and THE SYNC IS UNCONDITIONAL, in lib/cmd/version and its tests alike.
- **Found beside them and fixed (Done when 2):**
  - bin/.devbin/config.yaml: the step numbers ("step 8's push", "step 10's FAILED row") are now step names.
  - lib/cmd/release: principle 3 and principle 4, at each mention.
  - lib/helpers: ST0008 principle 1, and "the first paragraph".
  - lib/infra.dns: "the third" domain and its row.
  - lib/config: "the last two", "the third key".
  - lib/runlog: "Third member of the same block".
  - lib/cmd/fullcycle: "described the second".
  - lib/tmpl/handler and lib/tmpl/test.bats. No arm pins either template's text.
  - builtins.bats: "the second test below".
  - data.bats: "the second form".
  - dispatch.bats: "the last arm".
  - docs.bats: "The last test below".
  - doctor.bats: the title "a RULE 2 shortcut", where RULE 2 is defined nowhere.
  - dormancy.bats: "the last test in this file".
  - help.bats: "the last arm".
  - install.bats: "The second", "the last test in the manifest section" (it is in the upgrade section) and "the first arm".
  - release.bats: "line 936".
  - releasecut.bats: a fail message citing principle 4.
  - runlog.bats: "THE LAST ARM".
  - scaffold.bats: "the second one".
  - clean.bats: its numbered `ARM N` headings, which were out of order, and a TAP note naming "arm 2".
- **Left:** references to issue 0088's own rows ("0088 row 2", "row 3"), which are a dated record. Also left are words that refer back to what the same sentence has just named, the formats of output and arguments ("the first line", "the first word", "the third argument"), and dated history ("the first two attempts at this fix").
- **No behaviour change:** `shfmt -mn` is identical for every changed shell file apart from a test title in doctor.bats, a fail message in releasecut.bats and a TAP note in clean.bats, each declared in the commit message.
